documents.title: Advanced Perspectives on Hybrid Search Architectures: Combining BM25 with Dense Representations
documents.content:
Title: Advanced Perspectives on Hybrid Search Architectures: Combining BM25 with Dense Representations
Summary: An extended empirical study on ense vector search excels at conceptual similarity but struggles with exact acronyms and serial numbers. Reciprocal Rank Fusion of sparse lexical scores and dense embeddings achieves optimal recall Further analysis on scaling parameters.
Authors: Dat Tran, Lan Pham
Categories: Information Retrieval, Algorithms
Published: 2000-01-01

documents.content:
Title: Advanced Perspectives on Mitigating Ghost Vectors in Dense Retrieval via Idempotent Indexing

documents.content:
